name: MES Volume Booster
description: Boost the volume of any tab up to 600%, with a limiter against distortion and per-site memory. Free, private, no tracking. By MES (mes.fm).

boost-down.description: Boost the volume of this tab (quieter)

boost-off.description: Turn the boost off for this tab
